# FDG6005

> CONSIDER using events, instead of virtual members, to allow users to customize the behavior of a framework without the need for understanding object-oriented design.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 6.1.3 Events and Callbacks.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: the rule is about how users customize a framework. Not an analyzer candidate: whether an event can replace a virtual member is a design choice.
